# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# C02.09 - Functions: الفحوصات المتكررة تصبح دوال
def is_valid_age(age):
    """0 < age <= 120"""
    return isinstance(age, int) and 0 < age <= 120


def is_valid_name(name):
    """كلمتان على الأقل بعد التنضيف."""
    return isinstance(name, str) and len(name.strip().split()) >= 2


print(f"FUNC_VALID_AGE_TRUE={str(is_valid_age(34)).lower()}")
print(f"FUNC_INVALID_AGE_FALSE={str(not is_valid_age(999)).lower()}")
print(f"FUNC_NAME_RULE_OK={str(is_valid_name('سعاد حسن')).lower()}")
print(f"FUNC_SINGLE_WORD_REJECTED={str(not is_valid_name('محمود')).lower()}")

FUNC_VALID_AGE_TRUE=true
FUNC_INVALID_AGE_FALSE=true
FUNC_NAME_RULE_OK=true
FUNC_SINGLE_WORD_REJECTED=true
BOUNDARY_CHECKS={"age_120": true, "age_121": false, "age_34": true, "age_zero": false, "single_word_name": false, "two_arbitrary_words": true, "two_word_name": true}

findings.title: Age validation range misstated
findings.explanation: Narration claims is_valid_age accepts zero and any positive integer with no maximum, but implementation requires 0 < age <= 120 and execution rejects 0 and 121.
findings.suggestedChange: Correct narration to state is_valid_age accepts integers where 0 < age <= 120, rejecting 0 and values over 120.

findings.title: Name check misrepresented as legal identity verification
findings.explanation: Narration claims is_valid_name verifies real legal identity, but implementation only checks for at least two whitespace-separated words and execution accepts arbitrary two words.
findings.suggestedChange: Correct narration to state is_valid_name only checks text has at least two words after stripping, not legal identity.
